source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e, folder onesmallfavour; routes and dialogue checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

rec: Draynor Teleport with glory, 2 or more charges
Fishing and Mining Guild Teleport for Dwarven Mine with skills necklace, 4 or more charges
rewards: 2 x 10,000 Experience Lamps (Any skill over level 30)
The ability to make Guthix Rest tea.

st.t: Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village. CKR fairy ring or take cart from Brimhaven.
s: Is there anything else interesting to do around here?
Yes.

st.t: Talk to a Jungle Forester south of Shilo Village.
s: I need to talk to you about red mahogany.
Okay, I'll take your axe to get it sharpened.

st.t: Talk to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop.
s: Do you sharpen axes?
Look, can you sharpen this cursed axe or what?
Ok, ok, I'll do it! I'll go and see Aggie.

st.t: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village.
s: Could I ask you about being a character witness?
Let me guess, you're going to ask me to do you a favour?
Oh, okay, I'll see if I can find Jimmy.

st.t: Go down the trapdoor into the H.A.M. Hideout west of Lumbridge, picking its lock to open it. Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht in the south-east corner of the hideout.
s: I'm looking for Jimmy the Chisel.
And I suppose you need me to do you a favour?
Ok, Jimmy has to be worth more than a few scrawny chickens!

st.t: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
s: I need to talk to you about Jimmy.

st.t: Talk to Seth Groats in the farm north east of Lumbridge, across the river.
s: Oh, ok! I guess it's not that much further to Varrock!

st.t: Talk to Horvik in the armour shop north east of the Varrock square.
s: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages!
Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

st.t: Talk to the Apothecary in west Varrock.
s: Talk about One Small Favour.
Oh, ok, I guess it's not that far to the Barbarian Village.
I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

st.t: Talk to Tassie Slipcast in the Barbarian Village pottery building.
s: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!

st.t: Talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the west cavern of the Dwarven Mine.
s: Oh, come on...do something nice for Tassie.
Have you always been a gangster?
Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

st.t: Talk to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
s: Are you taking any new initiates?
Do you accept dwarves?
A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.
Yep, it's a deal.

st.t: Make Guthix Rest by using a bowl of hot water on an empty tea cup, then using 2 guams, a marrentill and a harralander on it.
Long-press Captain Bleemadge on top of White Wolf Mountain and choose Talk-to.
s: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!
Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

st.t: Talk to Arhein in Catherby.
s: I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.
Yes, Ok, I'll do it!

st.t: Talk to Phantuwti in the south west house of Seers' Village.
s: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?
What can I do to help?
Yes, Ok, I'll do it.

st.t: Enter the cave south east of the Fishing Guild.
Long-press the sculpture in the wall in the north east corner of the cave and choose Search.
Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
s: Chat.
I need to talk to you about a girl stuck in some rock!
Oh! Ok, one more 'small favour' isn't going to kill me...I hope!

st.t: Talk to Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard.
s: Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide.
Ask about iron oxide.
Okay, I'll do it!

st.t: Talk to Rantz in the Feldip Hills. AKS fairy ring or Feldip Hills Teleport.
s: I need to talk to you about a mattress.
Can you fill this mattress with feathers?
Ok, I'll see what I can do.

st.t: Talk to Gnormadium Avlafrim west of Rantz.
s: Rantz said I should help you finish this project.
Yes, I'll take a look at them.

st.t: Search each of the 8 landing lights on the landing strip to take out its uncut gem. Cut the gem with a chisel and put it back in the same light. The lights stand in two rows of four: from east to west, each row holds jade, red topaz, opal and sapphire. If you crush a gem, keep the crushed gem: Gnormadium sells up to 2 new ones of each type for 500 coins each.
Talk to Gnormadium Avlafrim again.
s: I've fixed all the lights!

st.t: Return to Rantz in the Feldip Hills. AKS fairy ring or Feldip Hills Teleport.
s: Ok, I've helped that Gnome, he shouldn't bother you anymore.

st.t: Return to Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard.
s: I have the mattress.

st.t: Return to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
s: Chat.
I have that iron oxide you asked for!

st.t: Get 5 pigeon cages from behind Jerico's house in central East Ardougne.
Enter the cave south east of the Fishing Guild. Be prepared to fight the Slagilith(level 92, takes reduced damage from anything other than pickaxes).
Stand in front of the sculpture in the north-east cavern, then read the animate rock scroll.
Kill the Slagilith. They take reduced damage from anything other than a pickaxe.
Read the animate rock scroll again.
Talk to Petra Fiyed.
Return to Phantuwti in the south west house of Seers' Village. Keep asking until he tells you about his weather vane.
s: I've released Petra, she should have returned.
I'll run you through if you don't give me that weather report.
Why can't you get a clear picture?
Which special Seers tools do you mean?
You're talking in riddles, just give me a straight answer!
What do you mean, 'special combination of items'?

st.t: Climb the ladder in Phantuwti's house, walk east and climb the next ladder to the roof (needs 36 Agility). Long-press the weathervane and choose Search.
Use a hammer on the weathervane.
Long-press the weathervane on top of the Seers' building and choose Search again.
Repair the vane parts on an anvil. You can find one in the north of Seers' Village.
Go back up to the Seers' roof by the two ladders. Use the ornament, the directionals and the weathervane pillar on the weathervane.
Return to Phantuwti in the south west house of Seers' Village.
s: I've fixed the weather vane!

st.t: Talk to Arhein in Catherby.
s: What did you want me to do again?
I have the weather report for you.

st.t: Long-press Captain Bleemadge on White Wolf Mountain and choose Talk-to.
s: Hey there, did you get your T.R.A.S.H?

st.t: Return to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
s: Hi there, the Gnome Pilot has agreed to take you to see the ogres!

st.t: Return to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the west cavern of the Dwarven Mine.
Kill 3 dwarf gang members until Hammerspike gives in. One dwarf gang member should appear after each kill.
Return to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the west cavern of the Dwarven Mine after killing his dwarf gang members.
Return to Tassie Slipcast in the Barbarian Village pottery building.
Spin the clay into a pot lid.
Fire the unfired pot lid.
Get a pot to put your lid on. There's one in the Barbarian Village helmet shop.
Use the pot lid on a pot.
Return to the Apothecary in west Varrock.
s: Talk about One Small Favour.

st.t: Return to Horvik in the armour shop north east of the Varrock square.
s: I have the tincture and the breathing salts.

st.t: Talk to Horvik once more in the armour shop north east of the Varrock square.
s: I have the five pigeon cages you asked for!

st.t: Return to Seth Groats in the farm north east of Lumbridge, across the river.
Return to Johanhus Ulsbrecht in the south of the H.A.M hideout.
s: You're in luck, I've managed to swing that chicken deal for you.

st.t: Return to Aggie in Draynor Village.
s: Good news! Jimmy has been released!

st.t: Return to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop.
s: I've returned with good news.

st.t: Return to a Jungle Forester south of Shilo Village. CKR fairy ring or take cart from Brimhaven.
s: Good news, I have your sharpened axe!

st.t: Return to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village.
s: Here's the red mahogany you asked for.

r: Combat gear to fight Slagilith and the dwarf gang members
